Assignments build on the week-by-week lecture material. Due dates and submission locations are posted in Canvas.

## Week 3

- [Assignment 1 - Implement relational operators](assignment-01-relational-operators.qmd): implement and test selection, projection, rename, and join over a small in-memory relation.
- [Assignment 2 - Relational algebra practice](assignment-02-relational-algebra-practice.qmd): read, trace, and write expressions using selection, projection, joins, and set operations.

## Week 5

- [Assignment 3 - Escape room database changes](assignment-03-escape-room-data-changes.qmd): insert, update, and delete data in your Activity 3 tables, test constraints, and explain the results.

## Semester-long

- [Semester project](../projects/capstone.qmd): develop a defensible data architecture around an authentic dataset and workload.

## Related course work

- [Labs and activities](../activities/index.qmd) are short in-class exercises with their own submission instructions when applicable.

## Default submission checklist

- Cite collaborators, sources, reused code, and material AI assistance.
- Remove passwords, tokens, and restricted data.
